conventions.bytes: All hashes, addresses, signatures and byte strings are 0x-prefixed hex. Hashes and signatures are lowercase as the engine emits them.
conventions.bigint: BigInt values inside event data / requests are encoded as {"$continuity.bigint":"<decimal>"} (the same marker the repository uses in its JSON fixtures). Decode them to arbitrary-precision integers before canonical encoding.
conventions.strings: utf8 inputs are given as JavaScript strings; hash them as their UTF-8 bytes.
conventions.canonical: canonicalText is the exact continuity-canonical/0.2 text whose UTF-8 bytes are hashed with Keccak-256 (see the canonical-encoding spec). It is included so a re-implementation can test keccak independently of its canonical encoder.
conventions.signer: Test private keys are the public development scalars 1, 1001 and 1003 (32-byte big-endian). Signatures are RFC 6979 deterministic (viem/@noble), so re-signing must reproduce them byte-for-byte.
